programs.title: Men
programs.desc: Harper retreats to the countryside in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering men grows into a fully-fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest.

programs.title: Delfin
programs.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin, an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small town outside of Buenos Aires. Delfin's ambition is to join a children's orchestra in a neighbouring village.

programs.title: 84 Charing Cross Road
programs.desc: Academy Award winners Anne Bancroft and Anthony Hopkins sparkle in this witty, touching drama about a transatlantic romance that begins at 84 Charing Cross Road.

programs.title: The Orator
programs.desc: This acclaimed film is the first entirely shot in Samoa. Saili, a taro farmer, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status by proving his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community.

programs.title: The Tunnel (Part 2)
programs.desc: In 1961 Berlin, as the Wall rises, Harry escapes East Germany but his sister Lotte is trapped. He leads a risky tunnel-digging rescue beneath the border, racing guards to secure freedom for them all.

programs.title: The Blind Man Who Did Not Want to See Titanic
programs.desc: Jaakko and Sirpa have never met face to face, but they talk on the phone every day. When he hears about her declining health, he decides to go meet her in another city.

programs.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book
programs.desc: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing, and through it embarks on a journey of self discovery and enlightenment.

programs.title: Pride & Prejudice
programs.desc: For the Bennet's, life is uneventful until the arrival of the rich gentleman Mr Bingley. Love is soon in the air for one of the Bennet sisters, while another may have jumped to a hasty prejudgment.

programs.title: A Room With A View
programs.desc: Lucy Honeychurch shares a brief romance with George Emerson in Florence. Yet as she tries to move on with her life and look for marriage elsewhere, can she truly forget the events of that summer?

programs.title: Bastille Day
programs.desc: When a reckless CIA agent and a brilliant pickpocket uncover a large-scale conspiracy, they must work together in order to take down a common enemy.

programs.title: Notes On A Scandal
programs.desc: A high school teacher befriends a younger art teacher, who is having an affair with one of her students. However, her intentions with this new friend also go beyond platonic friendship.

programs.title: Gosford Park
programs.desc: Set in the 1930s, Robert Altman's film takes place in an English country house where a weekend shooting party is underway. The story centres on the McCordle family, particularly the man of the house.
